summary: Frontend-only testing of Library pagination + sorting on /episodes. All functional requirements verified end-to-end against the live preview URL with 117 real episodes (read-only). Pagination, page-size options (10/25/50/100/All), range text, prev/next, numbered pages+ellipsis, localStorage persistence, numeric/scripture/published sort (both directions), search/filter page-reset, empty state, and backend scripture_key field all behave correctly.

verifications.default_state: range '1–25 of 117', 25 rows, pagination buttons [prev, 1, 2, 5, next] with ellipsis — matches spec
verifications.page_size_all: 117 rows, '1–117 of 117', no prev/next buttons rendered (correct)
verifications.persistence: After reload with pageSize=all, select trigger still shows 'All' (localStorage key library-page-size persists)
verifications.sort_scripture_asc: Genesis 2:18-25, Genesis 3:1-19, Genesis 3:15, Genesis 15 and 16, Genesis 16:7-13, Genesis 18:9-15, Genesis 21:1-7, Genesis 21:8-21 — canonical book, chapter, verse order
verifications.sort_scripture_desc: Starts with 2 Timothy, then Romans, then Acts — correct canonical reverse order (data set does not contain Revelation; library has no Revelation episode)
verifications.search_filter_resets_page: Navigated to page 2 (26–50 of 117), entered junk search → library-empty shown
verifications.status_filter: Filtering by 'Published' kept 117 episodes (all current episodes are Published in dataset)
verifications.api_scripture_key: GET /api/episodes returns 117 items, every row has integer scripture_key (e.g., John 2:1-11 → 42002001)

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Library.js useEffect for setPage(1) depends on `sort` object identity — this re-runs on every re-render where a new sort object was created. In practice fine because changeSort creates a new reference only on toggle, but ESLint deps are disabled; consider using sort.key+sort.dir primitives.

Minor: Pagination's pageList() uses string entries like '…2' which won't collide with numeric keys but relies on the Set entry being a number for the subsequent sort. Current implementation is correct; keep comment.
seed_data_creation: None — read-only test on real data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Library pagination & sort are fully functional on live URL. Dataset currently has 117 episodes, all Published, no Revelation present (so scripture desc tops out at 2 Timothy). Login inputs lack data-testid/name attributes — use nth input selectors or add testids if future auth tests needed.
